items.text: Seattle (Wed practice): DNP - LG Quenton Nelson (knee), RT Abraham Lucas (ankle) (both expected out), DT Jarran Reed (toe), OLB DeMarcus Lawrence (shoulder). LIMITED - LT Charles Cross, RG Anthony Bradford, WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle), DT Leonard Williams, LB Ernest Jones IV, QB Drew Lock (elbow). FULL - QB Sam Darnold; expected to start.
San Francisco QB (uncertain): Brock Purdy (ankle sprain, not high-ankle) DNP Wed; Shanahan said there is a 'possibility' he won't play. Mac Jones starts if not. Rapoport calls it minor, day-to-day.

San Francisco (Wed practice): DNP - WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis, workload), WR Jordan Watkins, S Siran Neal; rest - RB Christian McCaffrey, LT Trent Williams. LIMITED - CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot), CB Upton Stout, LB Dre Greenlaw. RT Colton McKivitz out for season; IR - WRs Ricky Pearsall, Christian Kirk.
